newsitem.title: USA: GreenPoint up in anticipation of earnings.
newsitem.headline: GreenPoint up in anticipation of earnings.

text.p: GreenPoint Financial Corp was up 2-1/4 to 56-1/4 Friday on anticipation the company will report good earnings next week, said analyst Martin Friedman of Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc. Friday's gain in the stock price was on top of a gain of 1-3/4 on Thursday. The company is expected to report fourth-quarter earnings January 22. The First Call consensus estimate is $0.79 per share.
Friedman said GreenPoint will probably do a little better than the consensus. He also said that on a cash flow basis the company was likely to report earnings of $1.15 per share.

Friedman said GreenPoint, a New York-based thrift, has been successful with a niche mortgage product requiring less documentation than the typical mortgage. He said the product has been successful in the New York area and has been taken nationwide.
A Wall Street trader noted that the stock has recieved favorable comments recently from several Wall Street firms. A spokesman for GreenPoint was not immediately available for comment.
